t: You're looking at the gate piers and overthrow at Lady Mico's Almshouses, in Tower Hamlets. The almshouses take their name from Jane, Lady Mico, who lived from 1634 to 1670 and was born Jane Robinson. She was an English benefactor. Her almshouses in London continue to this day. Clauses in her will aimed at relieving slavery led to the creation of Mico University College in Jamaica, and her bequest to Fairford's apprentices still helps educate pupils at the Farmor's School.
